title: Mission, tech stack, or roadmap?
intro: Every statement belongs in exactly one constitution document. File them.

cards.text: A satirical clinic where the patients are AI agents
Target audience: course students and conference-booth demo devs
Out of scope: real veterinary medical advice
Server-side TypeScript with the Hono framework
SQLite for data — it's a quick prototype
Tests run on Vitest; `npm test` must pass in CI
Phase 1: 'Hello Hono' — a served page with the clinic name
Phases 2–5 combined into one after replanning

debrief: mission.md answers *why this exists and for whom* — vision, audiences, scope boundaries. tech-stack.md is the engineering team's shared agreement — languages, frameworks, testing expectations. roadmap.md is the living *when*: a sequence of deliberately small phases, each of which will get its own feature spec. If a statement is about a single feature's tasks or done-criteria, it doesn't belong in the constitution at all — that's the feature spec's job.
